text: Workflow Canvas 是 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化 AI 项目工作台，提供网页侧边栏画布和本机执行 API。用户可把目标拆成相连的 AI 节点，在项目资料与模块会话中协作处理任务，并查看、审阅和下载版本化成果；还可回复节点问题、修改单个节点并更新受影响的下游步骤。AI 节点通过 Harness 宿主的 subagent 会话运行，画布和执行数据保存在本机。适合资料整理、研究写作和配置视频工具后的创作流程；需要 DeepSeek Harness，代码未要求额外 API key。

Workflow Canvas adds a visual project canvas to DeepSeek Harness. Connect AI steps, work with project materials, answer questions, revise a step, then review and download versioned deliverables. AI steps use Harness subagent sessions; project data stays in the local workspace.
我想把一个复杂目标拆成可视化的 AI 工作步骤。
能不能让多个 AI 步骤接力处理资料并交付文件？
我想在 DSH 里边看流程边修改某个环节。
让工作流的上游改动后只重跑受影响的步骤。
I want to organize a multi-step AI project as a visual workflow.
Can I revise one workflow step and update its downstream results?
资料整理和写作能不能拆成多个可追踪的 AI 环节？
I need to track progress and deliver files from a connected AI workflow.
Workflow Canvas 的功能「画布编排」：用户在侧边栏画布中编辑节点和连接，再运行画布工作流。
Workflow Canvas 的功能「节点问答」：运行遇到待回复节点时，用户可提交回答并继续同一运行。
Workflow Canvas 的功能「局部修订」：用户可为节点提交修改要求，保留既有版本并使下游节点过期后重跑。
Workflow Canvas 的功能「结果交付」：画布展示运行状态和成果，用户可查看并下载生成文件。

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · 工作流画布 · Workflow Canvas：把一个目标交给多个 AI 步骤协作，持续讨论、局部修改，最后拿到能使用的文件。

这是 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化项目工作台。适合研究写作、资料整理和配置后的短视频制作。项目保存目标、资料、流程、会话和成果版本；画布负责分工，模块工作区负责协作，成果页负责阅读、审阅与下载。

**当前公开版：v0.17.0 RC3。** 已在 npm 和 GitHub 发布，可直接安装；[插件市场收录申请](https://github.com/polang233/dsh-plugin-index/issues/201)等待代码复核。MIT 开源，插件免费；模型服务和可选视频工具按各自条件使用。

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · 先看一个完整例子：**六份资料 → 志愿者执行说明 → 正文、来源与清单 → 下载交付 ZIP。**

资料中有 78 把椅子，但不等于能报名 78 人。负责人确认上限 70 名后，后续步骤按这个决定继续整理。案例使用原创合成资料，便于核对流程与成果。

[下载完整示例](https://github.com/zzz123123lll/workflow-canvas-sidebar/releases/download/v0.17.0-rc.1/examples.zip)：解压后，`examples/portable-project.json` 包含项目定义和资料，`examples/article-delivery.zip` 包含文章、来源与清单。示例来自 RC1 的既有功能演示；安装使用当前 RC3。

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · 你可以做什么：- **资料到文章**：读资料、核对事实、写正文和来源，审阅后交付。
- **简短动态图形视频**：分镜/字幕、原创工程、真实渲染，再改片尾或字幕。
- **自定义文件任务**：修改一个通用 AI 模块，让它输出 Markdown、JSON 或自己的文件。
- 继续同一模块的对话；原生聊天修改回到画布，登记为新版本。
- 上游改稿只更新受影响步骤，旧版保留；共享知识经确认后用于后续项目。
- 当前工作和交付版分开选择，旧待办有明确的历史/替代状态。

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · 安装：受测平台为 Windows 11 x64，宿主基线 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5。请先安装并启动 Harness 一次。

**市场渠道**：在 Harness「插件 → 添加插件」填写 `dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar@0.17.0-rc.3`，或运行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar@0.17.0-rc.3
```

重启 Harness 后打开“画布”。市场包包含 Python 和 PDF 锁定依赖；AI 由 Harness 宿主执行，无需额外运行 `install.cmd`，也没有安装时自动执行的 `install` / `postinstall` 脚本。RC3 使用 npm 的 `next` 候选标签，请明确指定版本；现在可直接按包名安装，市场收录进度见[申请 #201](https://github.com/polang233/dsh-plugin-index/issues/201)。

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · 安装：**ZIP 渠道**：先安装免费的 PowerShell 7，然后：

1. 从本仓库的 **Releases** 下载 Windows x64 完整 ZIP，并核对 SHA256SUMS。
2. 解压到固定目录，例如 `C:\Tools\WorkflowCanvas`，双击 `install.cmd`。
3. 安装完成后重启 Harness，打开左侧“画布”，核对显示版本与下载包一致。
4. 在项目总览选“资料到文章”，先用原创合成示例完成真实 AI 任务，再换成自己的资料。

完整包自带 Python 与锁定依赖，核心安装无需全局Python或Node，依赖齐全时不会再次联网pip安装。模型运行仍需联网和Harness账号。Node、Chrome、FFmpeg及Remotion仅用于视频，见[配置步骤](docs/视频配置.md)。

第一次目标可写：“把资料整理为给新志愿者看的300字说明，保留来源，不补造日期地点。”需要回答时打开对应模块；普通讨论、回复待办、创建修订是三个不同操作。

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · 数据与升级：默认数据位于 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh-workflow-canvas`，机器路径保存在不入发行包的 `canvas-home.json`。安装只登记本插件；不会更改宿主账号或清空会话。升级覆盖插件文件时保留此配置，再运行安装程序；内置模板只补缺，不覆盖用户定义。

任务资料会按你的操作交给 Harness 配置的模型或工具处理；本插件不另设模型账号。诊断报告在本地生成，不会自动上传。市场安装沿用已有数据目录；从自定义目录的 ZIP 安装切换时，按[市场说明](docs/插件市场.md)继续使用原目录。

卸载默认解除插件登记并保留数据；`-ShowPlan` 可先查看。分享项目默认只导出定义，项目资料需主动选择；不附账号、会话或机器工具配置。

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · 开发与贡献：```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.lock.txt
.\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.lock.txt
.\.venv\Scripts\python scripts/verify.py

开发依赖与运行锁分别安装，详见[开发指南](docs/开发指南.md)。构建从官方锁定的Python ZIP和wheel组装运行时，不复制维护者的环境；npm 打包从完整 ZIP 取得相同文件，产物为 `.tgz` 与 `npm-manifest.json`。manifest 记录源码摘要、提交和资产哈希。无账号 CI 只验证其实际覆盖范围。

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · 开发与贡献：遇到问题请使用仓库的Bug/兼容报告模板，附版本、build、宿主版本和复现步骤。项目总览可以生成本地脱敏诊断，不要求提交私有对话。详见 [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md) 与 [SECURITY](SECURITY.md)。

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Workflow Canvas：A visual AI project workbench for DeepSeek Harness. Define a goal, connect AI steps, keep discussing and revising, and deliver versioned files.

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Workflow Canvas：**Source version: v0.17.0 RC3 — slim marketplace candidate.** RC2 exceeded the marketplace unpacked-size limit. RC3 uses the host subagent service instead of bundling a second Harness runtime; see [marketplace status and submission notes](docs/插件市场.md) for RC3 npm publication and listing status. The plugin is free; model accounts and optional video tools retain their own terms.

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Workflow Canvas：Built-in starters: sources to article, a configurable 30-second motion-graphics workflow, and a general Markdown/JSON file task. Projects keep their own goals, inputs, module conversations and results. Revisions preserve old files and invalidate only dependent steps. Current work and the selected delivery run are separate.

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Quick start：The tested baseline is Windows 11 x64 with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5. Install and open Harness once.

**Marketplace package:** add `dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar@0.17.0-rc.3` in Harness → Plugins → Add Plugin, or run:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar@0.17.0-rc.3
```

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Quick start：Restart Harness and open Canvas. The package includes Python and locked dependencies; it needs neither `install.cmd` nor an automatic `install` / `postinstall` script. RC3 uses the npm `next` tag, so select the explicit candidate version. While the marketplace listing is pending, the published ZIP remains available.

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Quick start：**ZIP installation:** install free PowerShell 7, download the complete Windows ZIP from Releases, verify SHA256SUMS, extract it to a stable directory, and run `install.cmd`. Restart Harness and open Canvas. The displayed version should match your downloaded package.

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Quick start：Choose Sources to Article, start with the original synthetic example, then replace it with project materials. Answer pending questions in the module workspace, review the result, and download the delivery. Python and locked core dependencies are bundled; no global Python or Node is needed for document tasks. Model execution still requires your Harness account and a network connection.

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Quick start：Video additionally requires Node, Chrome, FFmpeg and Remotion. Configure local paths in Project Overview → Environment and Video Tools. Remotion has separate [license conditions](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/license).

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Quick start：Data defaults to `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh-workflow-canvas`; machine configuration is excluded from releases. Upgrades preserve user definitions and data. Uninstall unregisters this plugin and retains data by default. Project sharing excludes accounts, conversation history, outputs and tool configuration; materials are opt-in.

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Quick start：Project materials are processed by the models and tools configured in Harness when you run tasks. The plugin has no separate model account. Diagnostics are generated locally and are never uploaded automatically. If your ZIP installation uses a custom data directory, follow the [marketplace migration notes](docs/插件市场.md) to keep using it.

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Development：Use Python 3.12, Node 24 and PowerShell 7. Create a virtual environment, install hash-locked `requirements-dev.lock.txt` and `requirements.lock.txt` separately, run `python scripts/verify.py`, then `python scripts/build.py --output dist`. Run `python scripts/npm_package.py --release-dir dist` to package the complete ZIP files into the npm `.tgz`, with `npm-manifest.json`. Builds use official hash-locked archives. Runtime binaries and user data do not belong in Git.

dsh-workflow-canvas-sidebar README · Development：Use the repository issue templates for bugs, feature requests and compatibility. Include version/build and reproducible steps, not private conversations. See [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md), [SECURITY](SECURITY.md), [architecture](docs/架构.md), and [Chinese setup guide](docs/安装与快速开始.md).
